rules: Do not rewrite integration-v1.2, the 81-record historical reconciliation, or prior current-overlay packages.
Use occurrence date for chronology when known; do not substitute publication date.
Qatari and Iranian statements establish actor positions; they do not self-verify a final Hormuz agreement.
An in-person mediation session is diplomatic movement, not proof that a comprehensive U.S.-Iran deal has resumed.
Kpler/AIS-visible vessel counts are methodology-bounded and are not exact total physical traffic counts.
Domestic rhetoric and negotiating behavior may diverge; motive for that divergence is not assumed without evidence.
